protocol: Pinned Sanford original k7 generator, 256 samples seed112233, last valid input token, random untrained pdg ptr11 4-layer model, two model initialization seeds. A0 head0 attention at final query compared against exact source position immediately after most recent identical prior char.
notes: Identity head A0 originally gives identical keys equal scores (untrained), so no recency tie-break; argmax picks earlier wrong source, while correct target receives ~1/24 mass.
Near-score rank and exact-ID-only rank boost latest matched candidate at layer0 to 100% across 512 tested cases, but this is an injected positional prior, not learned.
First-layer pointer-index accuracy does not prove 7-hop path or final language-model accuracy.
Exact ID mode decodes pointer via hard nearest token embedding; adds prior knowledge and compute.
